'''Alderaanians''' were natives, mostly [[Human/Legends|Human]], of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Notable members included [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], [[Winter Celchu]], [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], [[Cay Qel-Droma]], [[Wade Vox]], and [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]]. They were celebrated as a peaceful and cultured race, with a long-standing involvement in galactic politics.

When the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed Alderaan]], millions died. Thousands of Alderaanians survived the destruction of their homeworld because they were away on business or because they lived and worked in other star systems. Many of these survivors became some of the Alliance's most dedicated soldiers, motivated either by a desire for revenge or to prevent the Empire from destroying more worlds. A handful, however, became some of the Empire's most fanatical supporters, blaming Bail Organa's involvement with the Alliance for the destruction of everything and everyone they loved.

The surviving people [[Return (Alderaanian)|returned]] to the wreckage, known as [[the Graveyard]], to leave presents and pay respect to the ones who died there. Many former residents of Alderaan moved to a new planet, named [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]]. A colony of Alderaanians on [[Ejolus]] was [[Destruction of the Ejolus outpost|wiped out]] after the Imperial Star Destroyer [[Reprisal (Imperial II-class)|''Reprisal'']] tracked them down and destroyed the entire settlement. The destruction of Alderaan by the Empire caused thousands of Alderaanians who were off-world to immediately join the Rebellion, and the majority of Alderaanians serving in the Imperial military promptly defected or subtly aided the Rebellion from within.
